item.text: I’ll run this as a bounded tool experiment and keep the observations literal. I’m going to discover the subagent spawning interface first, then do the parent search and hand the selected refs to two fresh children.

The subagent tool is available as `multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent`; its no-history equivalent is `fork_context: false`. Now I’ll make the single parent search call and choose one result ref for each site.

The parent search used `web.run` with JSON keys `search_query` and `response_length`; the individual search query objects used key `q`. I’ll use `turn0search11` for Python and `turn0search0` for Mozilla, then start both children before doing any parent opens.

Record the exact call, returned reference, page title/URL, and either a short page excerpt or exact error. item.text:
**Experimental Report**

Parent initial search used tool `web.run` with JSON argument keys: `search_query`, `response_length`; each query object used key `q`.

Parent search refs selected:
- Python: `turn0search11` → `https://test.python.org/about/website/`
- Mozilla: `turn0search0` → `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/`

Children were spawned fresh with `multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent` and `fork_context: false`.

Python child:
- First transferred-ref open: `open({"ref_id":"turn0search11","lineno":null})`
- Returned ref: `turn1view0`
- Page: `About the Python Web Site | Python.org` / `https://test.python.org/about/website/`
- Result: fetched page, not error
- Control: `open({"ref_id":"https://www.python.org/","lineno":null})`
- Control ref: `turn3view0`
- Control page: `Welcome to Python.org` / `https://www.python.org/`
- Chosen link: source `turn1view0`, ID `0`, label `▼ Close`

Mozilla child:
- First transferred-ref open: `open({"ref_id":"turn0search0","lineno":null})`
- Returned ref: `turn2view0`
- Page: `Mozilla’s products — Mozilla (US) — Mozilla` / `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/`
- Result: fetched page, not error
- Control: `open({"ref_id":"https://www.mozilla.org/","lineno":null})`
- Control ref: `turn4view0`
- Control page: `Mozilla - Internet for people, not profit (US)` / redirected to `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/`
- Chosen link: source `turn2view0`, ID `0`, label `Products`

Parent validation after both children reported:
- `open({"ref_id":"turn1view0"})` returned `turn5view0`: `About the Python Web Site | Python.org` / `https://test.python.org/about/website/`
- `click({"ref_id":"turn1view0","id":0})` returned `turn5view2`: same Python page, with fallback notice and `▼ Close` / `▲ Back to Top` link behavior
- `open({"ref_id":"turn2view0"})` returned `turn5view1`: `Mozilla’s products — Mozilla (US) — Mozilla` / `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/`
- `click({"ref_id":"turn2view0","id":0})` returned `turn5view3`: same Mozilla products page

Child refs did not collide: Python child produced `turn1view0` / `turn3view0`; Mozilla child produced `turn2view0` / `turn4view0`.

No web-tool errors were observed. Protocol deviation: the parent search for Python selected the only Python.org-like result returned in the combined search output, but it was `test.python.org/about/website/`, not `www.python.org`.
